title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base - | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your kitchen counter with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, featuring a weighted base for steady tear-off and a felt pad to help protect surfaces in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern kitchens.

  • Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Weighted base: helps prevent tipping while tearing sheets
  • Felt pad: helps prevent scratching on countertops

Specs

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Overall size: 5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
